key_features: Wide Compatibility: Compatible with various devices including PCs, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, and mobile devices.
Multiple Color Options: Available in various colors to match personal style and gaming setup.
RGB Lighting Effects: Features vibrant, pulsating RGB illumination that enhances the gaming atmosphere.
Omnidirectional Microphone: Equipped with a 6 x 2.7mm microphone, the X13 captures clear voice input from all directions.
